say:1:1033469001:1.text: Yes, the Thorned Guards pledged loyalty to Master Eomir, but look what we got in the end!
say:1:1033469001:1.source_cn: 是的，荆棘卫队选择效忠伊米尔贤者，可最后却换来这样的结果。
say:1:1033469001:1.male: Yes, the Thorned Guards pledged loyalty to Master Eomir, but look what we got in the end!
say:1:1033469001:1.female: Yes, the Thorned Guards pledged loyalty to Master Eomir, but look what we got in the end!

say:2:1033469002:1.text: Fortunately, the Lucent Tree has recovered, or I would be tormented by remorse for the rest of my life in the Dark Forest.
say:2:1033469002:1.source_cn: 好在流荧树最终恢复如初。不然这份悔恨之情将会伴随着我，...
